Our main use of Rolle’s Theorem is in proving the Mean Value Theorem.

The Mean Value Theorem, which was first stated by Joseph-Louis Lagrange, is a slanted version of Rolle’s Theorem (Figure 4.13). The Mean Value Theorem guarantees that there is a point where the tangent line is parallel to the secant joining A and B.
